judged_text: The `update` action performs no update — it re-fetches and re-serializes the embedding without reading any params, so `saveChanges` in the client (admin-embedding.js.es6 `this.get('embedding').update({})`) is a silent no-op write path. Any admin who clicks a save control wired to this endpoint gets a success response while nothing is persisted; the PUT /admin/customize/embedding route exists in config/routes.rb but no setting can ever be changed through it, an undocumented ships-inert endpoint.

adjudication.rationale: The diff does add a PUT route (`put "customize/embedding" => "embedding#update"`) and a client action that calls `this.get('embedding').update({})`, but `Admin::EmbeddingController#update` ignores params and only `render_serialized(@embedding, ...)`, so the endpoint is effectively a no-op. However, in the shown template (`admin/templates/embedding.hbs`) there is no save control wired to `saveChanges`, and host changes are persisted via `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController` (create/update/destroy). So this is best characterized as an inert/dead update path rather than a demonstrable broken user-facing behavior in this diff.
